BoatCandidate.meaning: A distinct boat candidate being evaluated.

BoatOffer.meaning: A time-bound seller/market offer for one BoatCandidate. Price history belongs here and must not overwrite candidate identity.

MarinaOffer.meaning: A source-backed berth, liveaboard or wintering offer for a defined boat size and period.

LogisticsOption.meaning: One feasible or rejected delivery/logistics option for a candidate.

RefitPlan.meaning: Costed work split into mandatory pre-move work and post-move improvements. DIY time is not treated as free.

CostItem.meaning: A monetary input with original currency, timing and evidence/assumption status.

GateAssessment.meaning: Hard decision gates that subjective scoring cannot override.

Scenario.meaning: One evaluation composition linking a boat offer, marina offer, selected logistics option, refit plan, hard gates, FX assumptions and horizon.

EvaluationSnapshot.meaning: Derived decision metrics from one Scenario at one calculation state.

EvidenceRef.meaning: Recoverable pointer/label describing where a material fact came from without copying private source content into public Git.

habitabilityRule.pass: moveInPossible = YES AND privateCabins >= 2 AND berths >= 6.
habitabilityRule.fail: moveInPossible = NO OR known privateCabins < 2 OR known berths < 6.
habitabilityRule.unknown: Any required habitability field is UNKNOWN.
habitabilityRule.note: Permanent installed heating is not required for PASS if temporary safe shore-powered heating is feasible.

metrics.acquisitionCost: asking/current transaction price + due diligence + closing/document costs
metrics.selectedLogisticsCost: minimum cost among feasible LOCAL / SEA / ROAD options
metrics.overlapHousingCost: rent/temporary housing paid while move-in is not possible
metrics.diyShadowCost: diyHours × editable diyShadowRatePLN converted to scenario currency
metrics.monthlyRunRate: marina + insurance + maintenance reserve + utilities + heating + local fuel + communications + winter equivalent + misc
metrics.deltaVsRent: economicCost - rent alternative over the same horizon
metrics.downsideDeltaVsRent: downsideEconomicCost - rent alternative over the same horizon
metrics.walkAwayPrice: budget over horizon + netQuickSaleProceeds - non-purchase cash costs - diyShadowCost - risk buffer
metrics.maxPurchaseVsRent: rent alternative over horizon + netQuickSaleProceeds - non-purchase cash costs - diyShadowCost - risk buffer
metrics.valueScore: weighted utility/object-quality score independent of price

gateRule.fail: If any hard gate is FAIL, decisionState = WALK_AWAY.
gateRule.unknown: If no gate is FAIL and at least one hard gate is UNKNOWN, decisionState = HOLD.
gateRule.pass: Only when all hard gates are PASS may the economics produce a buy/price recommendation.

relations: Scenario references one BoatCandidate and may reference one BoatOffer
EvidenceRef may support BoatOffer, MarinaOffer, LogisticsOption, RefitPlan, GateAssessment or CostItem

aliases.Landed cost: costToHabitable when overlap housing is zero; deprecated as the primary KPI

deprecated.single resaleEUR as downside value: Use expected resale and quick-sale value separately for base and downside views.
deprecated.Hamburg-specific logistics template as p: Use listing location plus LOCAL / SEA / ROAD options per candidate.
